source.quote: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Shareholders ' Equity ... Common Stock Outstanding ... Shares ... (In millions, except per share data) ... Balances as of Jul 26, 2026 24,147 $ 24 $ 9,828 $ ( 25 ) $ 219,157 $ 228,984

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as NVDA. The latest 10-Q (quarter ended July 26, 2026; no later 10-Q was on EDGAR at the time of research) gives 24,147 million shares outstanding at quarter end in its statement of shareholders' equity, stated in millions; shares = 24,147 × 1,000,000. Its cover states only a rounded 24.1 billion at August 21, 2026. The 2026 proxy's precise count was 24,312,141,810 at March 23, 2026, older and since reduced by buybacks.
